claims.claim: Wiktech is OFFLIMITS' canonical moisture-evaporation technology and is available only on selected apparel; polyester alone is not presented as proof of drying speed.

Gladiator for men lists a knitted upper with KPU overlay, memory-foam insock and Phylon/TPR sole; Ethos lists Flyknit, a super-soft EVA insock and Phylon/TPR sole, with grip/slip-resistance language on its page.
Gladiator For Her lists Flyknit, a memory-foam insock and Phylon/TPR sole; Pulse X For Her lists mesh, a PU-moulded insock and Phylon/TPR sole.

No reviewed OFFLIMITS source proves that Flyknit dries faster than mesh or provides comparative treadmill, HIIT lateral-stability or lifting-specific testing; the article states these evidence limits explicitly.
The rewrite follows the user's ecommerce buying-guide flow and minimises outfit-building and lifestyle styling advice.

sources.extracted_facts: OFFLIMITS is an Indian performance footwear and athleisure brand. Canonical technology names include Wiktech, described as supporting faster moisture evaporation. Voice is motivational, inclusive and value-conscious.

Gladiator for men: knitted upper with KPU overlay, memory-foam insock, Phylon/TPR sole; page positions it for running, gym, errands and travel. Ethos: Flyknit upper, super-soft EVA insock in specifications, Phylon/TPR sole; page uses steady-grip/slip-resistance and gym/cross-training language. Neither page publishes comparative treadmill, HIIT lateral-stability, lifting or drying-time tests.

Gladiator For Her: Flyknit upper, memory-foam insock, Phylon/TPR sole. Pulse X For Her: mesh upper, PU-moulded insock, Phylon/TPR sole. Neither page publishes comparative treadmill, HIIT lateral-stability, lifting or drying-time tests.

Women's Printed Insert Tights: mid-rise, 240 GSM, 90% polyester/10% spandex, live page spells technology Wicktech. Men's Snow and Sonic tracksuits: zip, full sleeves, 90% polyester/10% spandex, live pages spell Wicktech. Women's WMN PCT CNS Tracksuit: hoodie, full sleeves, 100% polyester, live page spells Wicktech. Draft uses canonical Wiktech spelling and limits coverage to selected products.
